versions.changelog:
## Craft It Sooner 1.0

First release.

- The Sprinkler, Quality Sprinkler, Basic Retaining Soil, Quality Retaining Soil and Speed-Gro recipes unlock at a lower Farming level.
- Choose the level in the config: Light, Medium (default) or Strong. At Medium, the Sprinkler unlocks at Farming 1 instead of 2 and the Quality Sprinkler at 4 instead of 6.
- Ingredients and results stay as they are. The Iridium Sprinkler is unchanged.

## Craft It Sooner 1.1

Four more farm basics come sooner.

- Quality Fertilizer, Deluxe Speed-Gro, the Bee House and the Tapper now unlock earlier too, with the same config setting.
- At Medium (default): Quality Fertilizer at Farming 7 instead of 9, Deluxe Speed-Gro at 6 instead of 8, the Bee House at 2 instead of 3, and the Tapper at Foraging 2 instead of 4.
- Light: 8, 7, 2 and Foraging 3. Strong: 6, 5, 1 and Foraging 1.
- Your setting carries over. Ingredients and results stay as they are. The Keg and the Iridium Sprinkler keep their usual levels.
- If your level is already high enough, the game adds the new recipes when the save loads.

## Craft It Sooner 1.2

The settings are now in German too.

- The level setting now has a readable name, description and value labels in the in-game config menu, in English and German. Players with the game set to German see it in German; everyone else keeps English.
- Same recipes, same levels, same default, nothing else changes. Your setting carries over.
